channel.title: Majorca Daily Bulletin - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Majorca Daily Bulletin (majorcadailybulletin.com)

item.title: EMT bus deliberately hits taxi near Plaza España stop in Palma
item.description: Palma police investigate after an EMT bus of line 19 deliberately collided with a stationary taxi close to Plaza España-Estación Intermodal, injuring the driver.

item.title: Mallorca family-run restaurant competes for Spain’s best burger prize
item.description: The final judging panel will conduct a blind tasting of the 15 finalist burgers.

item.title: Spain’s airports get a starring role as Aena joins Film Commission board to boost filming at airports and promote screen tourism
item.description: This collaboration also seeks to encourage "screen tourism", mobilising audiences and fans of movies, series and documentaries to visit filming sites.

item.title: Films in English across Mallorca from Friday, 6 to Thursday, 12 March
item.description: New this week: The Bride!, Iron Lung, Pillion and family adventure Hoppers. Also screening are several Road to the Oscars contenders including Marty Supreme, Hamnet, Bugonia and Sinners.

item.title: Blue zone parking now effective in Consell with 30-minute limit
item.description: Under the new rules, parking remains free but is capped at 30 minutes in the designated blue zone. The penalty for parking violations is 100 euros.

item.title: Britons travelling to Spain will have to pay three times the original new ETIAS entry fee
item.description: It does not guarantee entry. When you arrive, a border guard will ask to see your passport and other documents and verify that you meet the entry conditions.

item.title: Mallorca events: What's On from Friday, 6 to Thursday, 12 March
item.description: This weekend the Fira del Fang takes place in Marratxi and the Fira Bona in Palmanyola plus Puerto Portals features the Classic Car Rally.

item.title: Top Mallorca hospital halts scheduled surgery due to ‘collapse’ in emergency services in Palma
item.description: The unions have estimated that there are more than 70 patients awaiting admission, some with more than 80 hours of waiting time, and has assured that there are no free beds left in the ICU.

item.title: Man under investigation in Mallorca for allegedly defrauding self-employed workers out of €2,000+ for boat repairs
item.description: He is believed to operate across several northern Mallorca municipalities.

item.title: Mallorca weather for Friday, March 6
item.description: Unsettled, showery weather is forecast well into next week.
